question: What sin did Śiva declare would arise for the goddess today?
premises: A sin is predicted to occur.
The sin arises from killing a brahmin.
It will befall the goddess today.
inference: Śiva declares that sin arising from brahmin-killing will truly befall the goddess today.
uncertainties: The attribution of brahmavadha in this context is not fully explained in this verse.
plain_english: Truly, sin arising from the killing of a brahmin will be yours today.
